desc: Ideation: parity-pool DP counting + lexicographic block-skipping construction
Implement complete solution: capped DP count(odds_left, evens_left, last_parity), total check with early [] return, and greedy k-th construction scanning candidates ascending

Validate on provided examples and edge cases — independently verified: (4,6)→[3,4,1,2] by hand-tracing block sizes (2,2,2 at position 1; k reduces 6→4→2, picks 3, then 4,1,2); (3,2)→[3,2,1]; (2,3)→[] since capped total=2<3; n=1,k=1→[1]; capping at original k is sound because running k never exceeds it, so capped blocks compare correctly; n=100 gives ~30k DP states with depth ≤100, well within limits
